sources.snippet: To address this challenge, this paper presents a hybrid deep-learning framework combining PaDiM and PatchCore for automated anomaly detection in industrial parts.

sources.title: PDF Computer Vision-Based Anomaly Detection in Industrial Components
sources.snippet: However, challenges remain in handling data imbalance, distribution shifts, and generalizing models across diverse industrial settings. This survey discusses benchmark datasets, evaluation metrics, and future research directions, such as explainable AI, hybrid learning, and scalable adaptive systems for next-generation industrial anomaly detection.
